tenniscommand.nokey: No Live Tennis API key is set. The broadcaster can add a free key (no card, 100 requests/day) from https://livetennisapi.com then run: !tennis apikey (key) -- WARNING: run that from the bot console or web panel, if you run it from chat, anyone watching chat can copy your key!
tenniscommand.apikey.usage: Usage: !tennis apikey [key / clear] -- WARNING: This should be done from the bot console or web panel, if you run this from chat, anyone watching chat can copy your info!
tenniscommand.apikey.set: Live Tennis API key saved. It is never shown in chat or written to the log.
tenniscommand.apikey.cleared: Live Tennis API key cleared. !tennis is inactive until a new key is set.
tenniscommand.board.empty: No tennis matches are live right now.
tenniscommand.rankings.empty: No ranking table is published right now.
tenniscommand.err.upgrade: Rankings need a Live Tennis API PRO key. The live board works on the free key.
tenniscommand.err.auth: The Live Tennis API rejected the stored key. The broadcaster should set a valid key with !tennis apikey.
tenniscommand.err.ratelimited: The Live Tennis API rate limit was hit. Try again shortly.
tenniscommand.err.unavailable: The Live Tennis API could not be reached right now.
tenniscommand.err.budget: The daily Live Tennis API request budget for this channel is used up. It resets at 00:00 UTC.
tenniscommand.cooldown: !tennis is on cooldown, try again in $1 second(s).
